title: Worker tokens never expire; the CI deploy role is AdministratorAccess
description: Findings 8 and a note from PR 501. Opaque worker tokens (customer host worker) have no expiry; owner tokens expire after an hour. The GitHub OIDC deploy role attaches AdministratorAccess (createGithubDeployRole), so the ECR statements added in PR 501 are no-ops: scope the role to what the deploy workflows need.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Triage 2026-10-14 (kept open): Verified on origin/develop: infra/lib/github-deploy-stack.ts line ~96 still attaches AdministratorAccess to the GitHub OIDC deploy role, so the ECR statements from PR 501 are no-ops. Opaque worker tokens (conversation/src/auth/worker-credentials.ts, worker-principal.ts) carry no expiry. Both findings stand; staging and production deploys are now dispatch-only (PR 540), which reduces but does not remove the exposure.

right_now_summary: Worker tokens still lack expiry, and the GitHub deploy role still has AdministratorAccess.
